title: Bread Bowl Bruschetta
description: A simple Italian-inspired appetizer featuring toasted bread bowls filled with a fresh mix of tomatoes, basil, and mozzarella.
instructions: 2. Slice the bread loaf into 1-inch thick rounds.
3. Place the bread slices on a baking sheet and toast in the oven for 10-12 minutes, or until crispy.
4. While the bread is toasting, mix together the diced tomatoes, chopped basil, and shredded mozzarella cheese in a large bowl.
5. Add the minced garlic to the bowl and stir to combine.
6. Drizzle the extra virgin olive oil over the top of the tomato mixture and season with salt and pepper to taste.
7. Once the bread is toasted, remove it from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes.
8. Use a spoon to hollow out the center of each bread slice, creating a small bowl.
9. Fill each bread bowl with the tomato mixture and serve immediately.
10. Garnish with additional basil leaves, if desired.
